text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see Irwin.
source_text: You see Irwin.

text: 你看见艾尔文。
source_text: 你看见艾尔文。

text: Oh boy, can't you leave me alone? I have enough problems on my hands already.
source_text: Oh boy, can't you leave me alone? I have enough problems on my hands already.

text: 噢孩子，你不能让我一个人呆会儿吗？我自己已经有够多的麻烦了。
source_text: 噢孩子，你不能让我一个人呆会儿吗？我自己已经有够多的麻烦了。

text: Problems? Maybe I can help you.
source_text: Problems? Maybe I can help you.

text: 麻烦？也许我能帮助你。
source_text: 麻烦？也许我能帮助你。

text: Like you are the only one with problems.
source_text: Like you are the only one with problems.

text: 看起来你是唯一惹上麻烦的人。
source_text: 看起来你是唯一惹上麻烦的人。

text: Okay, okay. No reason to yell at me.
source_text: Okay, okay. No reason to yell at me.

text: 好吧，好吧。没必要对我乱吼。
source_text: 好吧，好吧。没必要对我乱吼。

text: Hmm... I don't know. It takes a different caliber of hero than you. Listen, why don't you come back when you have a little more experience under your belt?
source_text: Hmm... I don't know. It takes a different caliber of hero than you. Listen, why don't you come back when you have a little more experience under your belt?

text: 呃……我不知道。它恐怕得需要比你更有实力的强者才能解决。听着，为什么不等你积累更多经验之后再回来呢？
source_text: 呃……我不知道。它恐怕得需要比你更有实力的强者才能解决。听着，为什么不等你积累更多经验之后再回来呢？

text: This is a tragedy, believe me. Nothing is the way it used to be. I have a small farm outside town and a few days ago a bunch of Raiders appeared out of nowhere and now use my home as their camp. They killed Pugsley, my donkey and they threatened #to kill me if I ever dare to come back.
source_text: This is a tragedy, believe me. Nothing is the way it used to be. I have a small farm outside town and a few days ago a bunch of Raiders appeared out of nowhere and now use my home as their camp. They killed Pugsley, my donkey and they threatened #to kill me if I ever dare to come back.

text: 这是场灾难，相信我。没有什么事会一帆风顺。我在城外有个小农场，几天前一伙歹徒突然在那里出现，并且占据了我的家作为他们的营地。他们已经杀了派斯依，我的驴子，并且威胁说如果敢再回去就一并干掉我。
source_text: 这是场灾难，相信我。没有什么事会一帆风顺。我在城外有个小农场，几天前一伙歹徒突然在那里出现，并且占据了我的家作为他们的营地。他们已经杀了派斯依，我的驴子，并且威胁说如果敢再回去就一并干掉我。

text: Just tell me where and I'll take care of the rest.
source_text: Just tell me where and I'll take care of the rest.

text: 你只需要告诉我他们在哪儿，剩下的就交给我。
source_text: 你只需要告诉我他们在哪儿，剩下的就交给我。

text: Sorry Irwin, but I have more important things to do.
source_text: Sorry Irwin, but I have more important things to do.

text: 对不起艾尔文，但我有更重要的事情得做。
source_text: 对不起艾尔文，但我有更重要的事情得做。

text: Really, you would do that? You know, I don't dare to go there any more. Why don't you come back and let me know when it is safe to go back home again?
source_text: Really, you would do that? You know, I don't dare to go there any more. Why don't you come back and let me know when it is safe to go back home again?

text: 真的吗，你想要那么做？你知道，我不敢再靠近那里。为什么不等你回来，然后再告诉我什么时候可以安全的回家呢？
source_text: 真的吗，你想要那么做？你知道，我不敢再靠近那里。为什么不等你回来，然后再告诉我什么时候可以安全的回家呢？

text: Listen freak, I told you to let me alone in the first place. Now beat it!
source_text: Listen freak, I told you to let me alone in the first place. Now beat it!

text: 仔细听, 我告诉过你让我一个人在这里呆着。那么现在滚吧！
source_text: 仔细听, 我告诉过你让我一个人在这里呆着。那么现在滚吧！

text: I knew you would chicken out. Everyone does when it comes to the Raiders.
source_text: I knew you would chicken out. Everyone does when it comes to the Raiders.

text: 我知道你会退缩。每个人听到要对付那帮强盗的时候都这个样。
source_text: 我知道你会退缩。每个人听到要对付那帮强盗的时候都这个样。

text: So, have you been able to teach those Raiders a lesson? Is my home safe again?
source_text: So, have you been able to teach those Raiders a lesson? Is my home safe again?

text: 那么，你已经把那些强盗教训了一顿？我的家现在安全了吗？
source_text: 那么，你已经把那些强盗教训了一顿？我的家现在安全了吗？

text: It sure is, buddy.

text: 当然了，我的朋友。
source_text: 当然了，我的朋友。

text: I didn't have the time yet to take care of it.
source_text: I didn't have the time yet to take care of it.

text: 我现在还没时间处理这件事。
source_text: 我现在还没时间处理这件事。

text: Oh, thank you so much. I am sorry I don't have any riches to give to you, but here, take this rifle for saving my home.
source_text: Oh, thank you so much. I am sorry I don't have any riches to give to you, but here, take this rifle for saving my home.

text: 喔，太感谢你了。很抱歉我没什么财产可以报答你，但是这个，但请拿走这把枪当作拯救我家的报酬。
source_text: 喔，太感谢你了。很抱歉我没什么财产可以报答你，但是这个，但请拿走这把枪当作拯救我家的报酬。

text: You're trying to fool me, right? Please don't play with me. Come back and let me know when it is really safe to get back into my home, will you?
source_text: You're trying to fool me, right? Please don't play with me. Come back and let me know when it is really safe to get back into my home, will you?

text: 你是在开玩笑，对吗？请不要愚弄我。请等我的家真正安全的时候再回来告诉我，好吗？
source_text: 你是在开玩笑，对吗？请不要愚弄我。请等我的家真正安全的时候再回来告诉我，好吗？
